//: Only for checks/md-render.tsx, which is the one check that cannot be built
with a bare `tsc <file>`: it imports React and renders real elements.
node_modules lives under web/, and this file does not, so TypeScript walking
up from checks/ never finds it. The paths mapping points bare specifiers at
it (baseUrl is gone in TS6, so the mapping is relative to this file).
Without it the build emits correct JS and prints two resolution errors
anyway - noise in a check's output is how a real failure gets missed.
